recommended_path: Stichting (foundation) + separate ANBI tax-exempt status from Belastingdienst
entity_types: Stichting (civil-law foundation; the standard foreign-founder/charity route)
ANBI status (not an entity — a separate Belastingdienst tax-exemption designation applied to either)

requirements.founders: No citizenship/residency requirement for founders or board; board may be entirely non-resident; stichting needs at least 1 board member (organs)
requirements.local_presence: Dutch registered office (postal address in the Netherlands; virtual-office provider acceptable)
requirements.documents: Notarial deed of establishment (stichtingsakte) drawn up by a civil-law notary; the notary registers the stichting with KVK and the UBO register

forms: Notarial deed (stichtingsakte) at a civil-law notary — no self-service registration form
KVK registration is handled by the notary (Business Register + UBO register)
ANBI application to Belastingdienst (separate, after formation)

fees.note: Verified verbatim on kvk.nl; supersedes prior '~EUR 82-85' estimate
KVK FAQ states the notary range explicitly; this is the dominant cost

fees.item: eHerkenning (needed later to file stichting taxes)
fees.amount: small annual fee (~€5-15 for basic user)
fees.source: https://www.kvk.nl/en/registration/registering-a-stichting/ (KVK notes a fee applies; amount is market-rate)
fees.note: Post-formation, not part of setup cost

timelines.formation: 1-2 weeks (notary availability is the pacing step)
timelines.anbi: 4-8 weeks after applying (Belastingdienst decision; longer if they request documents)

supersedes: Prior v2 'KvK fee ~EUR 82' corrected to €85.15 (kvk.nl fee page, valid from 01.01.2026)
